# Darkroom transitions

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/transitions`

## Summary

The 15 clip-edge transitions in five groups, and their duration range.

## Details

- Dissolve: `crossDissolve` (Cross dissolve)
- Dip: `dipToBlack` (Dip to black), `dipToWhite` (Dip to white)
- Wipe: `wipeLeft` (Wipe · from left), `wipeRight` (Wipe · from right), `wipeUp` (Wipe · from top), `wipeDown` (Wipe · from bottom)
- Push: `pushLeft` (Push · from left), `pushRight` (Push · from right), `pushUp` (Push · from top), `pushDown` (Push · from bottom)
- Slide: `slideLeft` (Slide · from left), `slideRight` (Slide · from right), `slideUp` (Slide · from top), `slideDown` (Slide · from bottom)
Duration: 0.1 to 5 seconds, default 1.
Directional transitions name where the entering clip comes from. A transition sits on the incoming clip and needs a clip before it on the same track.
Choosing by pace: cuts or short cross dissolves (0.3–0.5 s) for talking heads; dip to black between scenes or chapters; push/slide for energetic social edits.
